collections.title: 較早 Overall：文字增益（修正後 paired CI）
collections.notes: Each patient belongs to one stratum defined by group_event=max(y) within split; shared paired group draws, original task/split seed and 2000 replicates. Positive delta is AUPRC(with text) minus AUPRC(no text); OOF and 2024 are separate. No model retraining, prediction, selection or raw2025 access. Legacy overlapping-strata intervals are superseded and retained only as historical audit evidence; point estimates and model artifacts are preserved. Nominal descriptive 95% intervals are unadjusted for multiplicity; the earlier Overall cohort is not the current v3 Overall cohort.

collections.title: 目前 324 模型：2024 Decision curves
collections.notes: Exact accepted current2024 probabilities; no model fit or predictive model call. Treat-all prevalence and denominator are retained per model's own source cohort, including available-score subsets. This is point-estimate DCA on the original 1–15% risk range, not confidence bands or frozen2025 DCA. Plot the declared [0.01,0.15] x-range; no estimates outside this range were generated.
